thread:
sana: heads up everyone, cedar11b int8 canary showed a sudden latency surge and a couple OOMs during warmup :grimacing:
mike: logs? where did it spike (p50/p95)?
sana: p50 ok ~85ms but p95 jumped to 1.1s during mixed-length requests. saw 2 OOMs on node-42. snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z ERROR: cuda OOM while allocating 1.2G for KV cache
stack: runtime::alloc -> kv_cache::reserve -> evict_and_compact
histogram: [p50=85ms,p90=320ms,p95=1110ms,p99=2.4s]
```

oliver: same cluster. only reproduces for >512 token gens or when client sets max_new_tokens >= 256. short generations fine. suspect KV warmup + fragmentation.
jin: what's our default max_new_tokens in the canary config? thought we set 256 for throughput tests.
sana: canary used default=256 to match baseline. changing it helped regressions before but this time int8 path seems to amplify KV pressure.
ben: quick mitigation: drop default to 64 or 128, reduce per-gpu batch_size, enable reserve slots for prefetch. small config I propose:
```
--max_new_tokens_default=64
--batch_size_per_gpu=1
--reserve_slot_count=2
--kv_eviction_threshold=0.6
--batching-window-ms=6
```

oliver: also consider turning on "kv_trim_on_warmup=true" for int8 builds; we saw fragmentation improvements on phoenix7b onboarding last month.
sana: good call. i'll try ben's runtime flags + kv_trim on a 5-node canary (mix of short and long prompts).
mike: if that stabilizes latencies, we can roll forward. else fallback plan is to roll canary back to fp16 build and keep int8 disabled for cedar11b until we root cause.
deploy-bot: I triggered a rollback job: rollback/fp16-cedar11b-canary-2799991234 started by @mike :gear:
qa-bot: queued perf regression suite on fp16-canary and proposed-int8-config. ETA ~20m.
sana: action items: 1) run small canary with flags above, 2) collect KV cache fragmentation profile + allocator metrics, 3) run long-generation smoke to try reproduce. i'll post results here.
ben: if we need a faster fix, we could limit streaming chunk size to 64 tokens to reduce peak KV growth.
sana: noted. starting canary now. will update by 14:30. thanks :thumbsup:
mike: thx, ping @oliver if you see any regressions in dedicated pool while this runs.
oliver: will watch.
sana: update 14:28 — canary (5 nodes) with --max_new_tokens_default=64 + kv_trim_on_warmup=true shows p95 ~340ms, no OOMs so far. keeping it running for 10 more minutes.
sana: final update 14:45 — stable for 30min, promoted config to canary stable. opening a post-mortem ticket to track root-cause (likely int8 allocator interaction + high default max_new_tokens).
mike: great. add follow-ups: eval suite with 1k long gen prompts, and run memory compaction experiment on staging allocator.
sana: adding tasks to the onboarding board now.
